column7: 2026-11-06: parseJsonParameter(query, key) for the reports page filter was built then removed at the user's request (tree clean). Reason: JSON.parse rounds 64-bit account IDs (>2^53), e.g. 1274593846275813376 -> 1274593846275813400. Next session: don't re-add a plain JSON.parse helper; user is deciding between string IDs on the producer side or a big-int-aware decoder. Also the helper only worked on a bare query string, not a full link like /reports?filter=...; it would need to call extract() first.

Not implemented: it hits the same >2^53 ID precision loss as the removed helper. Offered (1) plain JSON.parse with readme warning, (2) big-int-aware decoding, (3) JSON.parse but keep the string if a number would lose precision.
